scenario: 在 <200ms 端到端 p99 预算下（Google/Spotify 量级），为十亿级向量搭一条语义搜索在线服务链路。
scenario_en: Under a <200ms end-to-end p99 budget (Google/Spotify scale), you serve semantic search over billions of vectors.
q: 这条在线服务链路的三个阶段依次是什么？
q_en: What are the three stages of this online serving pipeline, in order?
why: 三阶段：查询理解→ANN 召回→cross-encoder 重排。前段用便宜的召回缩候选，最后用贵而准的 cross-encoder 只精排少量，形成漏斗式延迟-精度权衡。
why_en: Query understanding encodes the query, ANN retrieval fetches candidates cheaply, then a cross-encoder re-ranks the top few accurately — a funnel trading cost for precision.
diagram:
flowchart LR Q["query"] --> U["查询理解
编码成稠密向量"] U --> A["ANN 召回
近似最近邻"] A --> R["cross-encoder 重排
精排 top 候选"] R --> O["结果"]
options: cross-encoder 重排 → ANN 召回 → 查询理解，先精排再召回，顺序完全颠倒
查询理解 → ANN 召回（近似最近邻）→ cross-encoder 重排（精排 top 候选）
查询理解 → 全量暴力打分整个语料 → 直接返回，完全不需要召回和重排两级
ANN 召回 → 查询理解 → BM25 关键词过滤，最后完全不做任何重排
options_en: Cross-encoder re-ranking then ANN retrieval then query understanding — re-ranking before retrieving, order fully reversed.
Query understanding then ANN retrieval (approximate nearest neighbors) then cross-encoder re-ranking of the top candidates.
Query understanding then brute-force scoring of the whole corpus then return directly, with no separate retrieval and re-ranking stages at all.
ANN retrieval then query understanding then BM25 keyword filtering, with absolutely no re-ranking at all.
optionExplanations: 顺序反了：没先编码 query、没先召回候选，就无从谈重排，重排永远在最后一级。
对，先编码 query、再用近似检索收窄候选，最后只让这个最贵的重排模型处理一小撮，兼顾了预算和精度。
全量暴力打分十亿向量每查约 10^9 次点积，根本跑不进 200ms，正是要用 ANN 绕开的。
查询理解必须在召回前（要先有 query 向量才能找近邻），且缺了重排精度不够。
optionExplanations_en: Order reversed: without encoding the query and retrieving candidates first, there is nothing to re-rank; re-ranking is always last.
Correct — encode, approximate-retrieve to shrink candidates, then cross-encoder re-rank a few, forming a latency-precision funnel under 200ms p99.
Brute-force scoring a billion vectors is ~10^9 dot products per query, impossible within 200ms — exactly what ANN avoids.
Query understanding must precede retrieval (you need the query vector to find neighbors), and dropping re-ranking loses precision.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 query 和候选文档拼在一起一起过模型打相关分，比双塔准但每对都要算一次、贵。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cross-encoder scores a query-document pair jointly in one pass — more accurate than a dual encoder but costs one forward pass per pair.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻：牺牲少量召回率换数量级检索加速。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor) trades a little recall for orders-of-magnitude faster retrieval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 99% 的请求都比这个延迟快；衡量尾部延迟而非平均。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: p99 latency is the value 99% of requests come in under, measuring tail latency rather than the average.

scenario: 语料 10 亿(1B)篇文档、每篇 768 维向量，你在考虑要不要直接对每个 query 暴力比对全库。
scenario_en: A corpus of 1B documents, each a 768-dim vector, and you consider brute-force comparing every query against the whole library.
q: 为什么必须用 ANN 而不能对十亿向量暴力打分？
q_en: Why must you use ANN instead of brute-force scoring a billion vectors?
why: 暴力检索每个 query 要对 10 亿个向量各做一次 768 维点积 ≈ 10^9 次向量运算/查询，在 <200ms p99 下根本跑不完。ANN 用图或聚类结构只看极少一部分候选，牺牲一点召回换数量级加速，是十亿级检索唯一可行路。
why_en: Brute force is ~10^9 dot products per query over a billion 768-dim vectors, impossible under 200ms, so ANN inspects only a tiny fraction, trading a little recall for orders-of-magnitude speedup.
options: 暴力检索每查约 10^9 次点积、跑不进 200ms；ANN 只看极少候选，牺牲少量召回换数量级加速
暴力检索其实很快，用 ANN 纯粹是为了省存储，跟延迟无关
暴力检索召回率不如 ANN，所以要用 ANN 来提高召回
10 亿向量暴力检索约 10^3 次运算，完全能跑进 200ms 预算，用 ANN 纯属习惯而非必要
options_en: Brute force is ~10^9 dot products per query and cannot fit 200ms; ANN inspects few candidates, trading a little recall for orders-of-magnitude speedup.
Brute force is actually fast; ANN is purely to save storage and has nothing to do with latency.
Brute force has lower recall than ANN, so ANN is used to improve recall.
Brute force over a billion vectors is ~10^3 operations and easily fits inside the 200ms budget; using ANN is pure habit, not necessity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对每个 query 与库中每个向量都算一次相似度，精确但 O(N) 太慢。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Brute-force search computes similarity between the query and every vector — exact but O(N) and too slow at scale.

termDefinitions.meaning: 真正相关的结果里被检索到的比例；ANN 用少量召回损失换速度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall is the fraction of truly relevant items that are retrieved; ANN sacrifices a little recall for speed.

optionExplanations: 对，十亿次量级的点积开销塞不进 200ms 预算，这就是必须用 ANN 的根本原因。
暴力检索慢在算力而非存储，把两者混为一谈搞反了因果关系。
暴力检索本是精确基线、召回天然最高，是 ANN 用近似换速度而非反过来。
十亿向量、每向量 768 维的点积总量远超 10^3，这个估计低估了好几个数量级。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a billion-scale dot-product bill cannot fit a 200ms budget, which is exactly why ANN exists.
Brute force is slow due to compute, not storage, so tying it to storage reverses the cause.
Brute force is the exact, highest-recall baseline; ANN is what trades a little of that recall for speed, not the reverse.
The real operation count for a billion 768-dim vectors is orders of magnitude above 10^3.

scenario: 召回质量是第一优先（漏检代价很高），语料规模中等、内存预算充裕能放下全部未压缩向量，追求 95%+ recall。
scenario_en: Recall is the top priority (misses are costly), the corpus is moderate, memory budget is ample to hold all uncompressed vectors, and you target 95%+ recall.
q: ANN 索引该选 HNSW 还是 IVF-PQ？
q_en: Should the ANN index be HNSW or IVF-PQ?
why: 选 HNSW：多层图贪心遍历，recall 达 95%+，但存完整向量+图边、内存约 4× 于 IVF-PQ，召回至上且内存够时最合适；内存紧时该换 IVF-PQ。
why_en: Pick HNSW: its multi-layer navigable graph hits 95%+ recall but stores full float32 vectors plus edges (~4x the RAM of IVF-PQ), which fits when recall is paramount and memory is available.
tradeoff: HNSW（recall 95%+·吃内存·图） vs IVF-PQ（省内存·recall 更低·聚类+压缩）
options: 选 IVF-PQ：把向量压缩到最省内存为止，即使召回明显掉不少也完全无所谓，反正内存最重要
选 HNSW：多层可导航图、recall 95%+，代价是存完整向量吃内存，正合「召回至上且内存够」
两个索引都不选，直接上暴力检索，认为中等规模暴力检索也完全稳稳能跑进 200ms 预算
选 BM25：用稀疏关键词检索直接替代向量索引，认为它的召回天然就是最高的、没有短板
options_en: Pick IVF-PQ: compress vectors to the absolute minimal memory, and losing a noticeable chunk of recall along the way is entirely fine since memory matters most.
Pick HNSW: a multi-layer navigable graph at 95%+ recall, at the cost of storing full vectors and high RAM, fitting 'recall paramount and memory available'.
Pick neither index and brute-force instead, assuming moderate scale can reliably and comfortably fit inside the 200ms budget too.
Pick BM25: replace the vector index outright with sparse keyword retrieval, assuming its recall is naturally the highest with no real weakness.
whenOtherWins: 当语料到十亿级、内存预算吃紧时改用 IVF-PQ——它用乘积量化把每向量压到约 1/4 内存，代价是 recall 降到 85–95%。
whenOtherWins_en: When the corpus reaches billion-scale and memory is tight, switch to IVF-PQ — product quantization cuts per-vector RAM to about a quarter at 85-95% recall.
optionExplanations: 题目明说召回至上、内存够，此时为省内存牺牲召回（IVF-PQ）方向不对。
对；HNSW 图检索 recall 95%+ 正好满足召回至上，内存充裕又扛得住它的高 RAM 开销。
暴力检索是 O(N)，即便中等规模也难稳定进 200ms p99，且无法随增长扩展。
BM25 是稀疏关键词匹配，抓不到语义近义，召回并非天然最高，替代不了稠密向量召回。
optionExplanations_en: The prompt says recall is paramount and memory is ample, so trading recall for memory (IVF-PQ) is the wrong direction.
Correct — HNSW graph search hits 95%+ recall, meeting recall-paramount, and ample memory absorbs its high RAM cost.
Brute force is O(N) and hard to keep under 200ms p99 even at moderate scale, and does not scale with growth.
BM25 is sparse keyword matching that misses semantic synonyms, so its recall is not naturally highest and cannot replace dense retrieval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分层可导航小世界图：多层图上贪心由粗到细找近邻，recall 高但存完整向量+图边、吃内存。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) greedily traverses a multi-layer graph coarse-to-fine for high recall, storing full vectors plus edges at high RAM cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先聚类成倒排单元、再用乘积量化压缩每个向量残差，省内存、召回略低。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IVF-PQ (Inverted File + Product Quantization) clusters vectors into cells then compresses residuals via product quantization, saving memory at slightly lower recall.

termDefinitions.meaning: 前 10 个返回结果里包含真正相关文档的比例，衡量 ANN 漏检程度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall@10 is the fraction of truly relevant docs captured in the top 10, gauging how much an ANN index misses.

scenario: 语料十亿(1B)级、768 维，内存预算很紧（HNSW 约需 3TB 放不下），能接受 recall 从 95%+ 降到 85–95%。
scenario_en: A billion-scale, 768-dim corpus with a tight memory budget (HNSW's ~3TB won't fit), and 85-95% recall is acceptable.
q: 这种内存受限的十亿级检索该选哪个 ANN 索引？
q_en: For this memory-constrained billion-scale retrieval, which ANN index?
why: 选 IVF-PQ：聚类成 Voronoi 单元只搜 nprobe 个、再乘积量化压缩残差，内存降到约 HNSW 的 1/4（约 0.7–1TB vs 3TB），recall 降到 85–95%。
why_en: Pick IVF-PQ: cluster into Voronoi cells searched via nprobe, then product-quantize residuals to about a quarter of HNSW's RAM (~0.7-1TB vs 3TB), accepting 85-95% recall.
tradeoff: IVF-PQ（内存约 1/4·recall 85–95%） vs HNSW（recall 95%+·内存约 4×）
options: 选 HNSW：不管内存预算多紧，认为召回永远越高越好，3TB 挤一挤总归能放得下，别无选择
选 IVF-PQ：聚类+量化压内存到 HNSW 的 1/4，recall 85–95%，适合内存紧的十亿级
选暴力检索：认定十亿级规模也能靠多机并行硬撑进 200ms 预算内，完全不需要用任何近似索引
把向量维度从 768 直接砍到 64 再硬上 HNSW，完全单纯靠这样粗暴降维来省内存就够了
options_en: Pick HNSW: no matter how tight memory is, assume higher recall is always better, and 3TB can somehow be squeezed in regardless.
Pick IVF-PQ: clustering plus quantization cuts RAM to about a quarter of HNSW at 85-95% recall, matching tight-memory billion-scale.
Pick brute force: assume billion-scale can still be forced under 200ms with enough parallel machines, no approximate index needed at all ever.
Slash dimensions straight from 768 to 64 and use HNSW, saving memory purely through this crude dimensionality cut alone.
whenOtherWins: 若内存预算充裕、且漏检代价极高需要 95%+ recall，就该反过来选 HNSW，用 4× 内存换更高召回。
whenOtherWins_en: If memory is ample and misses are very costly (needing 95%+ recall), flip back to HNSW, spending 4x RAM for higher recall.
optionExplanations: 内存明说放不下 3TB，硬上 HNSW 就是不看约束，会 OOM 或被迫大量分片。
对；IVF-PQ 的聚类 + 压缩正是为内存紧的十亿级设计，recall 85–95% 已被接受。
暴力检索是 O(N)，十亿级堆机器成本爆炸也难稳进 200ms，不是替代近似索引的正解。
粗暴砍维到 64 会显著损失语义信息、掉召回，比 IVF-PQ 的可控压缩差得多。
optionExplanations_en: Memory explicitly cannot hold 3TB; forcing HNSW ignores the constraint and would OOM or require heavy sharding.
Correct — IVF-PQ's clustering plus compression is built for tight-memory billion-scale, and 85-95% recall is accepted.
Brute force is O(N); billion-scale explodes machine cost and still struggles to hit 200ms — not a substitute for an approximate index.
Crudely cutting dimensions to 64 loses semantic information and recall, far worse than IVF-PQ's controlled compression.

termDefinitions.meaning: IVF 聚类把向量空间划成若干单元，每个单元由一个质心代表，查询只搜相关单元。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Voronoi cell is one cluster of the vector space around a centroid; IVF searches only the relevant cells.

termDefinitions.meaning: IVF 查询时实际搜索的单元数；越大 recall 越高但越慢。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: nprobe is the number of cells an IVF query actually searches; higher gives more recall but more latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把向量切成子向量分别量化成小码本索引，大幅压缩存储，代价是有损。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Product quantization splits a vector into sub-vectors, each quantized to a small codebook index, heavily compressing storage at some loss.

scenario: 面试官要你一句话说清 HNSW 和 IVF-PQ 的核心取舍，好按内存/召回预算选型。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to crisply contrast HNSW and IVF-PQ so you can choose by memory/recall budget.
q: HNSW 与 IVF-PQ 的核心取舍轴是什么？
q_en: What is the core tradeoff axis between HNSW and IVF-PQ?
why: 取舍轴是内存 vs 召回：HNSW 存完整向量+图边，recall 95%+ 但内存约 4×（约 3TB）；IVF-PQ 压缩省内存（约 0.7–1TB）但 recall 降到 85–95%。谁赢看内存预算和漏检容忍度。
why_en: The axis is memory vs recall: HNSW stores full vectors plus edges for 95%+ recall at ~4x RAM, while IVF-PQ compresses to a quarter of the memory at 85-95% recall.
tradeoff: HNSW（高 recall·高内存·亚毫秒） vs IVF-PQ（省内存·recall 略低·1–5ms）
options: 取舍轴其实是「构建速度 vs 查询速度」，两者的内存占用其实基本一样，没什么好比的
取舍轴是「内存 vs 召回」：HNSW 高 recall 但吃内存，IVF-PQ 省内存但 recall 略低
取舍轴是「稠密 vs 稀疏」，还认为 HNSW 是稀疏索引、IVF-PQ 才是稠密索引，划分完全反了
两者其实完全没有实质取舍，IVF-PQ 在所有维度上都完全优于 HNSW
options_en: The axis is actually build speed vs query speed, and their memory footprints are actually basically the same.
The axis is memory vs recall: HNSW gives high recall at high RAM, IVF-PQ saves memory at slightly lower recall.
The axis is dense vs sparse, and further claims HNSW is the sparse index while IVF-PQ is the dense one.
There is actually no real tradeoff at all here; IVF-PQ completely dominates HNSW on every single dimension.
optionExplanations: 构建速度确有差异（HNSW 更慢），但主轴是内存/召回，且两者内存差约 4×、并不相同。
对；HNSW 存完整向量换 95%+ recall 但内存约 4×，IVF-PQ 压缩省内存换 85–95% recall，这就是选型主轴。
两者都是稠密向量索引；BM25 才是稀疏，这个划分错了。
IVF-PQ 在 recall 上明显逊于 HNSW，并非全面占优，取舍真实存在。
optionExplanations_en: Build speed does differ (HNSW is slower), but the main axis is memory/recall, and their memory differs ~4x, not equal.
Correct — HNSW stores full vectors for 95%+ recall at ~4x RAM, IVF-PQ compresses to save memory at 85-95% recall — the selection axis.
Both are dense vector indexes; BM25 is the sparse one, so this split is wrong.
IVF-PQ is clearly worse on recall than HNSW, so it does not dominate and a real tradeoff exists.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分层图索引，recall 高但存完整向量吃内存。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) is a layered graph index with high recall but high memory from storing full vectors.

termDefinitions.meaning: 聚类倒排 + 乘积量化压缩，省内存、召回略低。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IVF-PQ (Inverted File + Product Quantization) clusters and compresses to save memory at slightly lower recall.

scenario: 为 1B×768 维语料估内存：HNSW 约需 3TB，IVF-PQ 约 0.7–1TB。
scenario_en: Estimating memory for a 1B×768-dim corpus: HNSW needs ~3TB, IVF-PQ ~0.7-1TB.
q: HNSW 相比 IVF-PQ 大约多用几倍内存，为什么？
q_en: Roughly how many times more RAM does HNSW use than IVF-PQ, and why?
why: 约 4×：HNSW 存未压缩 float32 向量加图边，IVF-PQ 用乘积量化压成几十字节码。这一差距决定十亿级能否塞进内存（约 3TB vs 0.7–1TB）。
why_en: About 4x, because HNSW stores uncompressed float32 vectors plus graph edges while IVF-PQ stores tens-of-bytes quantized codes, which decides whether billion-scale fits in RAM.
options: HNSW 存完整 float32 向量加图边、IVF-PQ 存压缩码，内存差距约 4 倍
两者内存基本相同，约等于 1 倍，差别其实只在查询速度的快慢这一点上而已
HNSW 要给每个向量都单独存一份完整的全语料副本，内存差距约 100 倍之多
HNSW 反而更省内存，约能省到 0.25 倍，因为图结构本身就是压缩
options_en: HNSW stores full float32 vectors plus graph edges while IVF-PQ stores compressed codes, so the memory gap is roughly 4x.
Memory is essentially the same, roughly a 1x ratio — the only difference is how fast queries run.
HNSW keeps a full corpus copy for every single vector, a memory gap of roughly 100x.
HNSW actually uses less memory, down to roughly 0.25x, because the graph structure is itself compression.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每维用 4 字节浮点存的未压缩向量，768 维约 3KB。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A float32 vector stores each dimension in 4 uncompressed bytes; 768 dims is about 3KB.

termDefinitions.meaning: HNSW 每个节点到邻居的连接，额外占内存但支撑快速导航。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Graph edges are HNSW's per-node links to neighbors, extra memory that enables fast navigation.

optionExplanations: 对，未压缩浮点向量比量化后的码大得多，二者差距正来自这点存储方式。
认为内存一样只看到了查询速度，两边存的向量表示形式完全不同。
把整套语料复制进每个节点太夸张，HNSW 真实开销来自向量+图边而非全量拷贝。
图结构记录的是邻居连接、不是压缩，实际比 IVF-PQ 更占内存而非更省。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — uncompressed floating vectors are simply much bigger than quantized codes, and that difference is the whole gap.
Assuming equal memory ignores that the two sides store completely different vector representations.
Copying the entire corpus onto every node is not what happens; HNSW's real cost is vectors plus edges, not full duplication.
Graph edges record neighbor links, not compression, so HNSW actually uses more memory, not less.

scenario: 面试官追问 HNSW 到底怎么在图上找近邻。
scenario_en: The interviewer probes how HNSW actually finds neighbors on its graph.
q: HNSW 的检索机制是怎样的？
q_en: How does HNSW's retrieval mechanism work?
why: 多层可导航小世界图：上层稀疏、长边负责「粗定位」，逐层下沉到密集底层做「精定位」，每层都贪心地走向离 query 更近的邻居。这种由粗到细的贪心遍历只访问极少节点就逼近最近邻，换来亚毫秒查询和 95%+ recall。
why_en: A multi-layer navigable graph: sparse upper layers do coarse positioning and dense lower layers refine, greedily hopping toward closer neighbors, reaching near-neighbors in sub-ms at 95%+ recall.
options: 把向量随机分桶，查询时扫描全部桶再合并去重，靠桶数量控制速度和召回质量
多层图上贪心由粗到细遍历：上层长边粗定位、逐层下沉精定位，只访问极少节点逼近最近邻
把每个向量压成码本索引，查询时对全库码逐个做线性扫描比对速度很慢
对整库向量做一次排序后，二分查找 query 落点直接当作最近邻返回
options_en: Randomly bucket vectors, scan all buckets per query and merge/dedup, controlling speed and recall quality by bucket count.
Greedy coarse-to-fine traversal on a multi-layer graph: long upper-layer edges position coarsely, lower layers refine, visiting few nodes to reach near-neighbors.
Compress each vector to a codebook index and linearly scan-compare every single code in the library, which is slow.
Sort the whole library of vectors once and binary-search where the query lands, returning that directly as the nearest neighbor.
optionExplanations: 随机分桶扫全部桶是 LSH 式思路，不是 HNSW；HNSW 靠图导航只走极少节点。
对；分层图 + 贪心由粗到细正是 HNSW，长边跳大步、下层精修，访问节点极少故亚毫秒。
压码本 + 线性扫描是 IVF-PQ/PQ 的机制，不是 HNSW 的图导航。
向量是高维的，无法像标量那样一维排序后二分查找最近邻。
optionExplanations_en: Random-bucket-and-scan is LSH-style, not HNSW; HNSW navigates a graph visiting very few nodes.
Correct — a layered graph with greedy coarse-to-fine traversal is HNSW: long edges take big hops, lower layers refine, few nodes visited so sub-ms.
Codebook compression plus linear scan is IVF-PQ/PQ's mechanism, not HNSW's graph navigation.
Vectors are high-dimensional and cannot be one-dimensionally sorted and binary-searched for nearest neighbor.

termDefinitions.term: navigable small world graph / 可导航小世界图
termDefinitions.meaning: 节点连着近邻也有少量长边，能几步跳到目标区域，支撑贪心近邻搜索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A navigable small-world graph links near neighbors plus a few long edges so a few greedy hops reach the target region.

scenario: 面试官追问 IVF-PQ 为什么又快又省内存。
scenario_en: The interviewer probes why IVF-PQ is both fast and memory-thrifty.
q: IVF-PQ 的两段机制（IVF 和 PQ）各做什么？
q_en: What do IVF-PQ's two parts (IVF and PQ) each do?
why: IVF 把向量分到 Voronoi 单元、查询只搜 nprobe 个（省时间）；PQ 把残差量化成小码、压到几十字节（省内存）。两者叠加实现十亿级低内存检索。
why_en: IVF clusters vectors into Voronoi cells so a query searches only nprobe cells (saves time), and PQ splits each residual into sub-vectors quantized to small codebooks (saves memory).
options: IVF 其实负责压缩存储、PQ 其实负责聚类路由，两者职责被完全对调彻底搞反了
IVF 聚类 Voronoi 单元只搜 nprobe 个（省时间）；PQ 把残差量化成小码（省内存）
IVF 和 PQ 都只负责压缩，检索环节仍然要暴力扫描全部库内每一个向量
IVF 建图做贪心遍历、PQ 存完整 float32 向量，跟 HNSW 一样非常吃内存开销
options_en: IVF actually does storage compression and PQ actually does clustering/routing — their roles are completely swapped.
IVF clusters into Voronoi cells so a query searches only nprobe cells (saves time); PQ quantizes residual sub-vectors into small codes (saves memory).
IVF and PQ both only handle compression, and retrieval still brute-force scans every single vector in the library.
IVF builds a graph for greedy traversal and PQ stores full float32 vectors, so overall it is just as RAM-hungry as HNSW.
optionExplanations: 职责说反了：聚类路由是 IVF、压缩是 PQ，互换就错了。
对；IVF 用 nprobe 缩小搜索范围省时间，PQ 量化残差省内存，合起来支撑低内存十亿检索。
IVF 的聚类恰恰让查询跳过大多数单元，不再暴力扫全库，这正是它省时间的来源。
建图贪心是 HNSW；IVF-PQ 存的是压缩码不是完整 float32，内存远低于 HNSW。
optionExplanations_en: Roles reversed: clustering/routing is IVF and compression is PQ, so swapping them is wrong.
Correct — IVF narrows the search via nprobe to save time, PQ quantizes residuals to save memory, together enabling low-memory billion-scale retrieval.
IVF's clustering lets a query skip most cells rather than brute-scan everything — that is where its time savings come from.
Greedy graph traversal is HNSW; IVF-PQ stores compressed codes, not full float32, using far less RAM than HNSW.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把向量按聚类归入倒排单元，查询只访问少数相关单元。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IVF (Inverted File index) assigns vectors to clustered cells so a query visits only a few relevant cells.

termDefinitions.meaning: 向量减去其所属单元质心后的差，PQ 量化的是这个残差而非原向量，更精。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A residual is a vector minus its cell centroid; PQ quantizes the residual rather than the raw vector for better precision.

scenario: 搜索里既有语义型查询（「适合下雨天的鞋」），又有精确关键词/型号（「Air Max 270」「错误码 E-4302」），稠密向量常漏掉精确匹配。
scenario_en: Search mixes semantic queries ('shoes for rainy days') with exact keywords/SKUs ('Air Max 270', 'error code E-4302'), and dense vectors often miss exact matches.
q: 怎么让系统同时抓住语义相似和精确关键词？
q_en: How do you capture both semantic similarity and exact keywords?
why: 用混合检索：稠密 ANN 抓语义近义，稀疏 BM25 抓精确词/型号/罕见 token，两路召回融合后再进重排。稠密擅长语义但会漏精确匹配，BM25 正好补这块盲区（Bing、Airbnb 都两路融合）。
why_en: Use hybrid retrieval: dense ANN for semantics plus sparse BM25 for exact terms/SKUs, fusing both before re-ranking, since dense misses exact matches and BM25 covers them.
tradeoff: 混合(稠密+BM25)（语义+精确都覆盖·两路成本） vs 纯稠密（语义强但漏精确关键词）
options: 只用稠密 ANN，把关键词硬编码进向量就已经够用，认为 BM25 完全是多余的
混合检索：稠密 ANN 抓语义 + 稀疏 BM25 抓精确关键词/型号，两路融合后再重排
只用 BM25 关键词检索就足够，语义查询也能靠同义词词典硬凑过去
把 query 拆成两次独立搜索交给用户自己去选结果，系统完全不做融合
options_en: Use only dense ANN; hard-coding keywords into the vector is already enough and BM25 is entirely redundant.
Hybrid retrieval: dense ANN for semantics plus sparse BM25 for exact keywords/SKUs, fused before re-ranking.
Use only BM25 keyword retrieval, which is already enough; semantic queries can be forced through with a synonym dictionary too.
Split the query into two separate searches and hand the choice entirely to the user, with no fusion by the system at all.
whenOtherWins: 若查询几乎全是自然语言语义型、极少精确关键词/型号，纯稠密 ANN 就够，省掉维护 BM25 一路的复杂度。
whenOtherWins_en: If queries are almost entirely natural-language semantic with rare exact keywords, pure dense ANN suffices and you skip maintaining a BM25 path.
optionExplanations: 稠密向量对罕见精确 token（型号、错误码）泛化差、常漏检，光靠它编码补不上这块。
对；稠密管语义、BM25 管精确匹配，融合两路正好覆盖各自盲区，是主流做法。
纯 BM25 抓不到「下雨天的鞋」这类无字面重合的语义近义，同义词典维护不动且覆盖不全。
让用户手动二选一是把系统的融合责任甩给用户，体验差且并未解决召回问题。
optionExplanations_en: Dense vectors generalize poorly to rare exact tokens (SKUs, error codes) and often miss them; encoding alone cannot fix that.
Correct — dense handles semantics, BM25 handles exact matches, and fusing both covers each other's blind spots — the mainstream approach.
Pure BM25 misses semantic synonyms like 'shoes for rainy days' with no literal overlap, and synonym dictionaries are unmaintainable and incomplete.
Making users manually choose offloads the system's fusion job onto them, hurting UX without solving recall.

termDefinitions.meaning: 经典稀疏关键词排序函数，按词频/逆文档频率打分，擅长精确词匹配。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BM25 (Best Matching 25) is a classic sparse keyword ranking function using term and inverse-document frequency, strong at exact matches.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同时跑稠密向量召回和稀疏关键词召回，再融合两路候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hybrid retrieval runs dense vector and sparse keyword retrieval together and fuses both candidate sets.

termDefinitions.term: dense vs sparse retrieval / 稠密 vs 稀疏检索
termDefinitions.meaning: 稠密用向量近邻抓语义；稀疏用关键词倒排抓字面匹配。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dense retrieval uses vector neighbors for semantics; sparse uses keyword inverted indexes for literal matches.

scenario: 十亿向量放不进单机，要分片。你担心分片后有的 query 的近邻散落在多个分片、漏检；召回质量是硬要求。
scenario_en: A billion vectors won't fit one machine, so you shard. You worry a query's neighbors scatter across shards and get missed; recall is a hard requirement.
q: 追求不损召回，分片该用文档分片(scatter-gather)还是聚类路由？
q_en: For no recall loss, use document sharding (scatter-gather) or cluster routing?
why: 用文档分片 + scatter-gather：按 doc ID/随机分片，每个 query 并行扇出到全部 N 个分片、协调器合并去重。因为不预设近邻在哪个分片，不会漏检，召回不受影响。代价是扇出随分片数线性增长（每查都打全部分片）。
why_en: Use document sharding with scatter-gather: partition by doc ID, fan every query out to all N shards in parallel, and merge, preserving recall at the cost of fan-out growing linearly with shard count.
tradeoff: 文档分片/scatter-gather（不损召回·扇出线性增长） vs 聚类路由（扇出小·可能漏跨簇近邻、热分片）
options: 聚类路由：按簇分片、查询只搜相关的少数簇，还声称这样做召回天然更高、扇出也是最小的
文档分片 + scatter-gather：随机分片、扇出全部再合并去重，不预设近邻位置故不漏检
把全部向量原样复制到每一台机器节点上，各自独立进行查询，反正就完全不用再做分片了
按查询实际发生的时间来分片，早上的查询固定走一批分片、晚上则走另外完全不同的一批
options_en: Cluster routing: shard by cluster and query only the few relevant clusters, claiming this gives naturally higher recall and minimal fan-out too.
Document sharding with scatter-gather: random shards, fan to all shards then merge/dedup, presuming nothing about neighbor location so nothing is missed.
Replicate all vectors as-is onto every single machine and query each independently, so sharding is never needed at all anymore.
Shard by the actual time a query occurs — morning queries hit one set of shards, evening queries hit an entirely different set.
whenOtherWins: 当扇出成本随分片数增长到扛不住、且能接受一点召回损失时，改用聚类路由只查相关簇来砍扇出（但要处理热分片和跨簇漏检）。
whenOtherWins_en: When fan-out cost grows unbearable with shard count and a little recall loss is acceptable, switch to cluster routing to cut fan-out (but handle hot shards and cross-cluster misses).
optionExplanations: 聚类路由只查相关簇，恰恰会漏掉跨簇近邻，召回不升反降，与「不损召回」的硬要求冲突。
对；随机分片 + 全扇出保证不遗漏任何分片里的近邻，召回不受影响，代价是扇出线性增长。
全量复制到每台机器内存根本放不下十亿向量，且不解决单机容量问题。
按时间分片与近邻分布无关，会把同一 query 的近邻切散，纯属乱分。
optionExplanations_en: Cluster routing queries only relevant clusters and can miss cross-cluster neighbors, lowering recall — conflicting with the hard no-loss requirement.
Correct — random sharding plus full fan-out guarantees no near-neighbor in any shard is missed, preserving recall at linear fan-out cost.
Full replication cannot fit a billion vectors in each machine's RAM and does not solve single-node capacity.
Time-based sharding is unrelated to neighbor distribution and scatters a query's neighbors — arbitrary partitioning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 查询并行发到所有分片(scatter)，各分片返回局部结果，协调器合并去重(gather)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Scatter-gather fans a query to all shards in parallel, then a coordinator merges and dedups their partial results.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次查询要打到的下游分片数；扇出越大协调和尾延迟压力越大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fan-out is the number of downstream shards one query hits; larger fan-out raises coordination and tail-latency pressure.

scenario: 为砍掉 scatter-gather 的扇出成本，你改成聚类路由：按簇归属分片，query 只发给它所属的少数簇。
scenario_en: To cut scatter-gather fan-out cost, you switch to cluster routing: shard by cluster membership and send a query only to its few clusters.
q: 聚类路由省了扇出，代价是哪两个风险？
q_en: Cluster routing saves fan-out, but at what two risks?
why: 两个代价：(1)召回损失——若 query 的真实近邻落在没被选中的簇里就漏检；(2)热分片——流量在簇上分布不均时，热门簇过载，负载均衡必须处理这种倾斜。省扇出是拿召回稳定性和负载均衡复杂度换的。
why_en: Two costs: recall loss when true neighbors fall in unselected clusters, and hot shards when traffic skews toward popular clusters, so the load balancer must handle skew.
tradeoff: 聚类路由（扇出小·省成本） vs 代价（跨簇近邻漏检 + 热分片倾斜）
options: 会显著增加内存占用，并让构建索引变慢
召回损失（近邻落在未选中的簇就漏检）+ 热分片（流量倾斜使热门簇过载）
会破坏 embedding 版本兼容性，触发跨空间失真
没有真正代价，聚类路由在所有维度都优于 scatter-gather
options_en: It significantly raises memory usage and slows index building.
Recall loss (neighbors in unselected clusters get missed) plus hot shards (skewed traffic overloads popular clusters).
It breaks embedding version compatibility and triggers cross-space distortion.
There is no real cost; cluster routing beats scatter-gather on every dimension.
optionExplanations: 聚类路由不改变向量存储量，内存/构建不是它的主要代价，跑偏了。
对；只查部分簇会漏跨簇近邻（掉召回），且流量倾斜会造出热分片，负载均衡要专门抗倾斜。
分片路由与 embedding 版本无关，不会引发跨空间失真，那是另一类问题。
它明确用召回稳定性换扇出，代价真实存在，并非全面占优。
optionExplanations_en: Cluster routing does not change how many vectors are stored, so memory/build is not its main cost — off target.
Correct — querying only some clusters misses cross-cluster neighbors (recall drop), and skewed traffic creates hot shards the load balancer must counter.
Shard routing is unrelated to embedding versions and does not cause cross-space distortion — a different problem.
It explicitly trades recall stability for less fan-out, so the cost is real and it does not dominate.

termDefinitions.meaning: 承接远超均值流量的分片，易过载，需负载均衡抗倾斜或再分裂。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hot shard takes far above-average traffic and risks overload, needing load-balancing against skew or further splitting.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按簇归属分片，query 只路由到相关簇，扇出小但可能漏跨簇近邻。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cluster routing shards by cluster and routes a query only to relevant clusters, cutting fan-out but risking cross-cluster misses.

scenario: 每个向量分片都可能被单点故障拖垮，且单副本吞吐不够。
scenario_en: Each vector shard risks a single point of failure, and one replica's throughput is insufficient.
q: 为什么每个分片通常复制 R=3 份？
q_en: Why is each shard typically replicated R=3?
why: R=3 同时买到两样：吞吐——三个副本可并行分摊查询流量；容错——挂一个还剩两个继续服务、不丢分片。3 是常见经验值，在冗余成本和可用性间取平衡。
why_en: R=3 buys both throughput (three replicas share query load in parallel) and fault tolerance (one can die and two keep serving), a common balance of redundancy cost and availability.
options: 为了把索引的构建速度直接提升三倍来节省时间
为了同时拿到吞吐（副本分摊流量）和容错（挂一个还有两个服务）
为了让每个副本各自只存三分之一的数据，从而节省内存
为了让检索的 recall 召回率直接提高到原来的三倍
options_en: To directly triple index build speed and save time.
To get both throughput (replicas share load) and fault tolerance (one dies, two still serve).
To let each replica store only a third of the data on its own, saving memory.
To directly triple the retrieval recall rate.
optionExplanations: 复制不加速构建；每个副本都得各自建一遍索引，构建量反而更多。
对；R=3 让三副本并行扛流量（吞吐）又留冗余（容错），是可用性与成本的常见折中。
副本是完整拷贝不是分片，每份都存全量，不省内存。
复制不改变检索算法，recall 由索引类型决定，不会因副本数变化。
optionExplanations_en: Replication does not speed builds; each replica must build its own index, so build work increases.
Correct — R=3 lets three replicas share load (throughput) while leaving redundancy (fault tolerance), a common availability-cost tradeoff.
Replicas are full copies, not shards; each stores everything, so no memory is saved.
Replication does not change the retrieval algorithm; recall depends on index type, not replica count.

termDefinitions.term: replication factor R / 副本数 R
termDefinitions.meaning: 每个分片保留的完整副本数；R=3 表示 3 份，用于吞吐和容错。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Replication factor R is how many full copies each shard keeps; R=3 means three, for throughput and fault tolerance.

scenario: 同一批热门/趋势查询反复打进来，编码器每次都重编 query 很浪费，且很多完全相同的查询本可复用最终结果。
scenario_en: The same hot/trending queries hit repeatedly; re-encoding each query wastes the encoder, and many identical queries could reuse the final results.
q: 两级缓存分别缓存什么、各自失效节奏怎么定？
q_en: What do the two cache levels store, and how is each invalidated?
why: 两级：embedding 缓存存 query→向量、可长驻；result 缓存存最终 top-K、TTL 绑索引重建节奏。一个缓存计算、一个缓存结果，失效节奏不同。
why_en: A query-embedding cache (query to vector, skipping the encoder, long-lived since encoders rarely change) and a result cache (final top-K, absorbing 30-40% of traffic at Bing scale, with TTL tied to index rebuild cadence).
tradeoff: embedding 缓存（编码器稳·可长驻） vs result 缓存（依赖索引·TTL 绑重建节奏）
options: 两级都只缓存最终结果，只是一个存内存一个存磁盘，两者失效节奏完全一模一样
embedding 缓存存 query→向量、可长驻；result 缓存存最终 top-K、TTL 绑索引重建节奏
embedding 缓存存的其实是最终结果、result 缓存存的其实是 query 向量，两者职责整个完全互换了
只需要一级 result 缓存就完全够用，query embedding 每次都重新计算，缓存向量根本没有意义
options_en: Both levels only cache final results, one in memory and one on disk, with identical invalidation timing across the board.
The embedding cache stores query-to-vector and persists; the result cache stores final top-K with TTL tied to index rebuild cadence.
The embedding cache actually stores final results and the result cache actually stores query vectors — their entire roles are swapped.
One result cache alone is already entirely enough; recompute query embeddings every single time, since caching vectors carries no value at all.
whenOtherWins: 索引重建很频繁（近实时更新）时，result 缓存 TTL 必须缩得很短甚至基本失效，此时更依赖 embedding 缓存和扩容而非结果缓存。
whenOtherWins_en: When the index rebuilds very frequently (near-real-time), the result cache TTL must shrink to near-useless, so you lean on the embedding cache and scaling rather than result caching.
optionExplanations: 两级缓存的失效节奏不同：编码器稳→embedding 可长驻，索引常变→result 要短 TTL，说成一样就错了。
对；embedding 缓存省编码、可长驻；result 缓存省整条链路但要随索引重建失效，两者失效节奏不同。
职责说反了：embedding 缓存存的是向量、result 缓存存的是最终结果。
热门/趋势查询反复重编 query 很浪费，缓存 query 向量能直接跳过编码器，绝非没意义。
optionExplanations_en: The two caches invalidate differently: encoders stable so embeddings persist, index changes often so results need short TTL — calling them identical is wrong.
Correct — the embedding cache saves encoding and persists; the result cache saves the whole pipeline but must lapse when the index rebuilds — different invalidation cadences.
Roles reversed: the embedding cache stores vectors and the result cache stores final results.
Repeatedly re-encoding hot/trending queries wastes the encoder; caching query vectors skips it — far from pointless.

termDefinitions.term: query embedding cache / 查询向量缓存
termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存 query→向量，命中即跳过编码器；编码器少变故可长驻。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A query-embedding cache stores query-to-vector so hits skip the encoder; it persists long since encoders rarely change.

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存某 query 的最终 top-K 结果，命中省整条链路，但依赖索引、需按重建节奏失效。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A result cache stores a query's final top-K, saving the whole pipeline on a hit but tied to the index and invalidated per rebuild.

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存条目的存活时长，到期即失效重取。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL (Time To Live) is how long a cache entry stays valid before it lapses and is refetched.

codeSample:
SET emb:{queryHash} "<vector bytes>"                    -- no TTL, encoder rarely changes
SET res:{queryHash}:{indexVer} "<topK json>" EX 3600    -- TTL tied to index rebuild cadence

scenario: Bing 量级的搜索流量里，很大一部分是重复/趋势查询。
scenario_en: At Bing-scale search traffic, a large share is repeated/trending queries.
q: result 缓存在 Bing 量级大约能吸收多少比例的流量，意味着什么？
q_en: About what share of traffic does the result cache absorb at Bing scale, and what does it imply?
why: 约 30–40%（经验值，源于查询分布长尾但头部集中）。含义是：三到四成请求直接命中结果缓存、不走编码+召回+重排的完整链路，等于把后端算力和尾延迟压力砍掉三四成，是撑住 <200ms p99 和控成本的关键杠杆。
why_en: About 30-40%, meaning three to four in ten requests skip the full encode-retrieve-rerank pipeline, cutting backend compute and tail latency by that much.
options: 命中率约 30–40%：直接命中缓存、不走完整链路，大幅减轻后端算力与尾延迟
缓存基本没什么用，命中率仅约 1%，主要还是靠扩容硬扛流量
几乎所有查询都完全相同，命中率高达约 99%，后端几乎不用怎么工作
命中率同样也约 30–40%，但只减少了存储成本、完全不影响延迟
options_en: Hit rate is about 30-40%: requests hit cache directly, skipping the full pipeline, greatly easing backend compute and tail latency.
Caching barely helps at all, at about a 1% hit rate, mostly relying on scaling to carry the load.
Nearly all queries are completely identical, at a hit rate as high as about 99%, so the backend hardly does any work.
Hit rate is likewise about 30-40%, but it only cuts storage cost and does not affect latency at all.

termDefinitions.term: cache hit rate / 缓存命中率
termDefinitions.meaning: 命中缓存、无需走完整计算链路的请求占比；越高越省算力和延迟。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cache hit rate is the share of requests served from cache without the full pipeline; higher saves compute and latency.

optionExplanations: 对，命中缓存意味着跳过整条编码召回重排的链路，直接压低尾延迟和后端负载。
把命中率压到 1% 明显低估了热门和趋势查询反复出现的程度。
99% 命中率意味着几乎不存在长尾查询，跟真实搜索流量分布不符。
命中缓存省下的是整条计算链路，延迟同样受益，不只是省了存储。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a cache hit skips the whole encode-retrieve-rerank pipeline, directly cutting tail latency and backend load.
A 1% hit rate badly underestimates how often hot and trending queries repeat.
A 99% hit rate implies almost no long-tail queries, which does not match real search traffic.
A cache hit skips the entire compute pipeline, so latency benefits too, not just storage.

scenario: 200ms p99 端到端预算要拆给四个阶段：查询理解、ANN 召回、cross-encoder 重排、网络/序列化。
scenario_en: A 200ms p99 end-to-end budget must be split across query understanding, ANN retrieval, cross-encoder re-ranking, and network/serialization.
q: 四个阶段里哪个通常吃掉最大一块预算，为什么？
q_en: Which stage usually takes the biggest slice of the budget, and why?
why: cross-encoder 重排最贵（约 50–80ms）：逐对拼 query+候选过大模型，最准也最重。其余三段各 20–50ms，所以要用漏斗把进重排的候选数压小。
why_en: Cross-encoder re-ranking (~50-80ms), because it runs a heavy model per query-candidate pair — the most accurate and most expensive stage, so the funnel keeps its candidate count small.
options: cross-encoder 重排（约 50–80ms）：逐对拼 query+候选过大模型，最准也最贵
网络/序列化阶段最贵（约 120ms）：gRPC 和 protobuf 序列化是最大瓶颈
查询理解阶段最贵（约 100ms）：编码 query 比其它阶段都要慢得多
ANN 召回阶段最贵（约 90ms）：近似检索是整条链路里最重的一步
options_en: Cross-encoder re-ranking (~50-80ms): a heavy model per query-candidate pair, the most accurate and most expensive.
Network/serialization is priciest (~120ms): gRPC and protobuf serialization is the biggest bottleneck.
Query understanding is priciest (~100ms): encoding the query is far slower than any other stage.
ANN retrieval is priciest (~90ms): approximate retrieval is the heaviest step in the whole pipeline.

termDefinitions.meaning: 高性能 RPC 框架与二进制序列化格式，用于分片间低延迟通信。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: gRPC is a high-performance RPC framework and protobuf its binary serialization, used for low-latency inter-shard communication.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻：牺牲少量召回率换数量级检索加速。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor) trades a little recall for orders-of-magnitude faster retrieval.

optionExplanations: 对，逐对把 query 和候选拼进大模型算相关分，这份计算量天然比其它三段都重。
网络和序列化通常只是 20–30ms 的固定开销，远撑不到成为最贵一段。
查询理解走的是轻量蒸馏/ONNX 编码器，本该被压得很快，不会是最慢一段。
ANN 召回靠近似结构跳过大部分向量，开销远低于逐对打分的重排阶段。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — pairing the query with each candidate through a heavy model naturally costs more than any single other stage.
Network and serialization are normally a fixed 20-30ms overhead, nowhere near the priciest stage.
Query understanding runs a light distilled/ONNX encoder meant to be fast, not the slowest stage.
ANN retrieval skips most vectors via an approximate structure, far cheaper than pairwise re-ranking.

scenario: 重排深度 k 是最影响质量的旋钮。k=20 会漏掉 ANN top-20 之外的好文档；但 cross-encoder 耗时随 k 线性增长。
scenario_en: Re-rank depth k is the most impactful knob. k=20 misses good docs just outside ANN's top-20, but cross-encoder cost grows linearly in k.
q: 为什么说重排深度 k 是最关键的旋钮？
q_en: Why is re-rank depth k the most critical knob?
why: k 卡在召回覆盖与延迟成本的交叉点：太小漏掉 ANN 边缘的相关文档，太大让 cross-encoder 逐对打分线性膨胀爆预算。调 k 就是在精度和 200ms 间找平衡。
why_en: k sits exactly on the recall-coverage vs latency-cost tradeoff: too small misses relevant docs just outside ANN's top-k, too large blows the budget since cross-encoder cost is linear in k.
tradeoff: k 小（省延迟·漏 ANN 边缘好文档） vs k 大（覆盖广·cross-encoder 耗时线性爆预算）
options: 因为 k 决定的是索引本身占用的内存大小，跟查询延迟完全没有任何关系
因为 k 卡在召回覆盖与延迟成本的交叉点：太小漏好文档、太大让重排线性爆预算
因为 k 越大 recall 就必然越差，所以理应把它设成能设的最小值
因为 k 只会影响缓存命中率高低，完全不会影响重排本身的质量好坏
options_en: Because k determines how much memory the index itself uses, with absolutely no relation to query latency.
Because k sits on the recall-coverage vs latency-cost crossover: too small misses good docs, too large makes re-ranking blow the budget linearly.
Because larger k must always make recall worse, so it should be set to the smallest value possible.
Because k only affects cache hit rate, with no effect at all on re-ranking quality itself either way.
whenOtherWins: 当 ANN top-k 已经稳定覆盖真实相关文档（召回很高）时，把 k 调大只会白烧 cross-encoder 算力，此时该保持小 k。
whenOtherWins_en: When ANN's top-k already reliably covers the relevant docs (high recall), enlarging k just wastes cross-encoder compute, so keep k small.
optionExplanations: k 是重排送进 cross-encoder 的候选数，直接决定重排耗时，跟索引内存无关。
对；k 太小漏 ANN 边缘好文档、太大让逐对打分线性膨胀爆 200ms，正是精度-延迟的关键旋钮。
k 大通常提高覆盖（召回），不是变差；问题在延迟成本，不是召回下降。
k 改变的是重排阶段能看到的候选数量，直接影响精度而不只是缓存命中。
optionExplanations_en: k is the number of candidates fed to the cross-encoder, directly setting re-rank cost, unrelated to index memory.
Correct — too-small k misses ANN-edge docs, too-large k blows 200ms via linear pairwise scoring — the key precision-latency knob.
Larger k usually improves coverage (recall), not worsens it; the issue is latency cost, not recall drop.
k changes how many candidates the re-ranking stage actually sees, directly shaping precision rather than just caching.

termDefinitions.term: re-rank depth k / 重排深度 k
termDefinitions.meaning: 从 ANN 候选里取前 k 个送 cross-encoder 精排；cross-encoder 成本随 k 线性增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Re-rank depth k is how many ANN candidates go to the cross-encoder; its cost grows linearly with k.

scenario: 200ms 预算下，你想把重排深度从 100 提到 300 拿更高覆盖，但整段 300 都过完整 cross-encoder 会爆预算。
scenario_en: Within 200ms, you want to raise re-rank depth from 100 to 300 for more coverage, but running all 300 through the full cross-encoder blows the budget.
q: 怎么在不爆预算的前提下把重排漏斗从 100 拓宽到 300？
q_en: How do you widen the re-rank funnel from 100 to 300 without blowing the budget?
why: 两段式重排：轻量模型先给 300 个候选粗打分（15ms）剪到 50，再用 cross-encoder 精排这 50 个（40ms）。漏斗拓宽到 300 拿覆盖，但最贵一段只处理 50 个。
why_en: A two-stage re-ranker: a light distilled model coarse-scores 300 in ~15ms and prunes to 50, then the full cross-encoder scores those 50 in ~40ms, widening the funnel without proportional latency.
tradeoff: 两段式（拓宽覆盖·延迟不随深度线性涨·多一个模型） vs 单段 full cross-encoder（简单·深度一大就爆预算）
options: 直接把这 300 个候选全部一次性送进完整的精排模型打分，超预算就靠拼命调大机器硬扛过去
两段式：轻量模型粗排 300→50（15ms），再用 cross-encoder 精排 50（40ms）
把重排深度直接大幅砍回到 20 来节省时间，彻底放弃拿到更高覆盖的目标追求
跳过重排这整个环节，直接返回 ANN 给出的 top-300 原始结果，靠召回顺序当作最终排序
options_en: Run all 300 candidates straight through the full re-ranking model and add more machines whenever it goes over budget.
Two-stage: a light model coarse-ranks 300 to 50 (15ms), then the cross-encoder scores those 50 (40ms).
Cut re-rank depth straight back to 20 to save time, completely abandoning the goal of higher coverage altogether.
Skip this re-ranking step entirely and return ANN's top-300 as-is, using retrieval order as the final ranking result.
whenOtherWins: 当目标深度本就很小（如 50 以内）、单段 full cross-encoder 已能在预算内跑完时，就没必要加蒸馏预筛这层复杂度。
whenOtherWins_en: When the target depth is already small (say ≤50) and a single full cross-encoder fits the budget, the distilled pre-filter layer is unnecessary complexity.
optionExplanations: 把 300 个候选全丢给这个精排模型，耗时随数量线性上涨，直接撑爆 200ms，加机器也压不下单请求的串行延迟。
对；蒸馏预筛把最贵一段的输入从 300 压到 50，漏斗拓宽拿覆盖、延迟不随深度线性涨。
砍回 20 是放弃覆盖目标，与「想提到 300」的诉求相反。
ANN 顺序不够精，跳过重排会直接损失精度，违背要更高质量的初衷。
optionExplanations_en: Running all 300 through the full cross-encoder blows 200ms linearly, and machines cannot compress one request's serial latency.
Correct — the distilled pre-filter cuts the expensive stage's input from 300 to 50, widening the funnel for coverage without linear latency growth.
Cutting back to 20 abandons the coverage goal, opposite to wanting 300.
ANN order is not precise enough; skipping re-ranking loses accuracy, defeating the goal of higher quality.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用大模型指导训练出的小模型，精度略降但推理快得多，适合做粗排预筛。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A distilled model is a small model trained under a large one's guidance, slightly less accurate but much faster, ideal for coarse pre-filtering.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先用轻量模型粗排一大批剪枝，再用重型 cross-encoder 精排剩下少量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A two-stage re-ranker coarse-ranks a large set with a light model then finely re-ranks the small remainder with a heavy cross-encoder.

scenario: 召回阶段用双塔编码器、重排阶段用 cross-encoder，面试官问二者为何分工。
scenario_en: Retrieval uses a dual encoder and re-ranking uses a cross-encoder; the interviewer asks why they split the work.
q: 双塔编码器和 cross-encoder 在「精度 vs 成本」上如何分工？
q_en: How do dual encoder and cross-encoder split on the precision-vs-cost axis?
why: 双塔独立编码 query 与文档、文档向量可离线预算，便宜能扫十亿库但精度有限；cross-encoder 逐对联合打分，贵但最准。便宜的双塔做海量召回、贵的只精排少量。
why_en: A dual encoder embeds query and doc separately (docs precomputed, cheap, scales to billions, limited precision), while a cross-encoder scores each pair jointly (one forward pass per pair, expensive, most accurate).
tradeoff: 双塔（可预算·便宜·扫十亿·精度有限） vs cross-encoder（逐对·贵·最准·只用于少量重排）
options: 双塔其实是逐对联合打分最准的一方、cross-encoder 才是独立编码最便宜的一方，分工说反了
双塔独立编码可预算文档向量、便宜、扫十亿但精度有限；cross-encoder 逐对联合打分、贵但最准
两者的精度和成本表现其实完全一样，选哪个纯粹看个人使用习惯
cross-encoder 其实也能提前预算文档向量，所以召回和重排都应该只用它
options_en: A dual encoder actually scores pairs jointly (most accurate) and a cross-encoder actually encodes independently (cheapest) — the roles are reversed.
A dual encoder embeds independently, precomputes doc vectors, is cheap and scales to billions but limited precision; a cross-encoder scores pairs jointly, expensive but most accurate.
Their precision and cost performance is actually identical across the board; the choice is purely personal habit.
A cross-encoder can actually precompute doc vectors too, so it alone should be used for both retrieval and re-ranking.
optionExplanations: 说反了：联合打分是 cross-encoder、独立编码是双塔，角色互换即错。
对，双塔靠可预算向量换来了规模，那个联合打分的重排模型则换来了精度，两者各司其职。
二者精度-成本差异明显，正因如此才分召回/重排两段，不是习惯问题。
这个重排模型需要 query 才能和文档联合打分，无法离线预算文档向量，扫不了十亿库。
optionExplanations_en: Reversed: joint scoring is the cross-encoder, independent encoding is the dual encoder — swapping is wrong.
Correct — the dual encoder's precomputable vectors buy scale, and the cross-encoder's pairwise scoring buys precision — each does its own job.
Their precision-cost differ sharply, which is exactly why retrieval and re-ranking are split — not habit.
A cross-encoder needs the query to jointly score with a doc, so it cannot precompute doc vectors or scan a billion-doc library.

termDefinitions.meaning: query 与文档各用一塔独立编码成向量，文档向量可离线预算，召回便宜。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dual encoder embeds query and doc with separate towers; doc vectors precompute offline, making retrieval cheap.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 query 与候选拼一起联合打相关分，最准但每对都要一次前向、贵。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cross-encoder jointly scores a query-candidate pair — most accurate but one forward pass per pair, expensive.

scenario: Staff 级答题：你想量化 IVF-PQ 的 nprobe 旋钮对召回和延迟的影响，而不是只说「调大更准」。
scenario_en: Staff-level answer: you want to quantify how IVF-PQ's nprobe knob trades recall for latency, not just say 'higher is more accurate'.
q: 把 nprobe 从 32 调到 64，大致付出和换回什么？
q_en: Raising nprobe from 32 to 64 roughly costs and buys what?
why: 大致多付 3ms 延迟、换回 2% recall（示例量级）：nprobe 调大会多搜几个 Voronoi 单元，候选更多但扫描更久。能报出这种数量级取舍就是 Staff 信号。
why_en: Roughly +3ms latency for about +2% recall (illustrative), because larger nprobe searches more Voronoi cells, covering more candidates at more scan time.
options: 多约 3ms 延迟、换回约 2% recall：多搜几个 Voronoi 单元覆盖更多候选
延迟和召回其实都完全不会有任何变化，nprobe 只会影响内存占用的大小而已
召回直接翻倍、延迟却完全不发生变化，这几乎是白拿的免费提升机会，毫无代价
延迟直接降了一半、召回也直接升了一半，调大 nprobe 简直是有百利而无一害
options_en: About +3ms latency for about +2% recall: searching more Voronoi cells covers more candidates.
Neither latency nor recall actually changes at all; nprobe only affects how much memory gets used.
Recall directly doubles while latency stays completely unchanged — essentially a free lunch.
Latency directly halves and recall directly rises by half, so raising nprobe is simply all upside with zero downside.

termDefinitions.meaning: IVF 查询时实际搜索的 Voronoi 单元数；调大提高召回但增加扫描延迟。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: nprobe is how many Voronoi cells an IVF query searches; raising it lifts recall but adds scan latency.

optionExplanations: 对，多搜几个 Voronoi 单元换来更全的候选覆盖，但扫描更多单元自然要花更多时间。
nprobe 恰恰决定实际搜索的单元数，直接牵动召回与延迟，说它只碰内存不成立。
召回不会无代价翻倍，多搜单元必然带来额外扫描时间，免费提升不现实。
调大 nprobe 只会增加延迟去换召回，不会让延迟反而下降，这个方向说反了。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — searching a few more Voronoi cells widens coverage, but scanning more cells naturally costs more time.
nprobe is exactly the cell count actually searched, driving both recall and latency — claiming it only touches memory is wrong.
Recall does not double for free; scanning more cells always adds scan time.
Raising nprobe only adds latency in exchange for recall — it cannot lower latency, so this reverses the direction.

scenario: 面试速记：200ms p99 预算在四个阶段的大致分配。
scenario_en: Interview cheat: roughly how the 200ms p99 budget splits across four stages.
q: 补全 200ms 端到端预算的阶段分配：
q_en: Fill in the stage allocation of the 200ms end-to-end budget:
text: 查询理解（编码）约 {{20–30}} ms（蒸馏/ONNX 编码器）；ANN 召回约 {{30–50}} ms；cross-encoder 重排约 {{50–80}} ms（最准最贵）；网络/序列化（gRPC、protobuf、合并）约 {{20–30}} ms。
text_en: Query understanding (encode) ~{{20–30}} ms (distilled/ONNX encoder); ANN retrieval ~{{30–50}} ms; cross-encoder re-ranking ~{{50–80}} ms (most accurate, most expensive); network/serialization (gRPC, protobuf, merge) ~{{20–30}} ms.
why: 记住形状：重排吃最大一块（50–80ms），召回其次（30–50ms），编码和网络各 20–30ms。这不是硬公式而是把 200ms 目标拆到各阶段的经验分配，用来倒逼每步选多重的模型、多深的 k。
why_en: Remember the shape: re-ranking takes the biggest slice, then retrieval, with encoding and network at 20-30ms each, an empirical split that drives model and depth choices.

termDefinitions.meaning: 高性能 RPC 框架与二进制序列化格式，用于分片间低延迟通信。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: gRPC is a high-performance RPC framework and protobuf its binary serialization, used for low-latency inter-shard communication.

scenario: 查询理解阶段只分到 20–30ms 预算，但把 query 编码成稠密向量默认要过一个大 transformer。
scenario_en: The query-understanding stage gets only a 20-30ms budget, yet encoding the query to a dense vector defaults to a large transformer.
q: 怎么让 query 编码在 20–30ms 预算内跑完？
q_en: How do you fit query encoding inside a 20-30ms budget?
why: 用蒸馏小编码器 + ONNX 运行时压进 20–30ms。full-size 编码器精度略高但太慢；召回阶段容忍度高、后面还有 cross-encoder 兜底，是对的取舍。
why_en: Use a distilled small encoder plus an ONNX runtime to fit encoding into 20-30ms, since the full encoder is too slow and the cross-encoder later compensates for the small precision loss.
tradeoff: 蒸馏/ONNX 编码器（快·进预算·精度略降） vs full transformer（更准·太慢·爆 20–30ms）
options: 在线直接用最大号的 transformer 模型来做编码，精度优先、延迟被放在完全次要的位置
用蒸馏小编码器 + ONNX 运行时压进 20–30ms，精度损失由 cross-encoder 兜底
跳过编码这一步完全不做，直接把 query 的原始文本送进 ANN 索引里做检索
把 query 的编码工作整体放到离线批处理阶段预先算好，在线阶段完全不做编码
options_en: Use the largest transformer model directly online for encoding, prioritizing precision with latency entirely a secondary concern.
Use a distilled small encoder plus an ONNX runtime to fit encoding into 20-30ms, with the cross-encoder covering the precision loss.
Skip this encoding step altogether and feed the raw query text straight into the ANN index for retrieval.
Precompute the query's encoding entirely offline in a batch stage ahead of time, encoding nothing online whatsoever.
whenOtherWins: 若延迟预算宽松（如离线/近线批量检索，无 200ms 约束），可用 full-size 编码器换更高编码精度。
whenOtherWins_en: If the latency budget is loose (offline/near-line batch retrieval with no 200ms cap), a full-size encoder buys higher encoding precision.
optionExplanations: 最大号 transformer 在线编码通常远超 20–30ms，直接爆掉查询理解的预算。
对，把编码模型换小、加 ONNX 加速就能塞进预算，后续重排还会纠正这点精度损失。
ANN 索引比的是向量，query 必须先编码成向量，送原文没法做近邻检索。
query 是在线才来的，无法离线预算它的编码，这条不成立。
optionExplanations_en: A largest transformer online usually far exceeds 20-30ms, blowing the query-understanding budget outright.
Correct — distillation plus ONNX fits encoding in budget, and retrieval tolerates small precision loss with the cross-encoder compensating later.
The ANN index compares vectors, so the query must be encoded first; raw text cannot do neighbor search.
Queries arrive online and cannot be precomputed offline, so this option is invalid.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从大编码器蒸馏出的小模型，在线编码快、精度略降。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A distilled encoder is a small model distilled from a large one, encoding fast online at slightly lower precision.

scenario: 两位候选人都画出了「编码→ANN→cross-encoder 重排」的三段架构，但一个被评 L5、一个被评 Staff+。
scenario_en: Two candidates both draw the encode→ANN→cross-encoder pipeline, but one is rated L5 and the other Staff+.
q: 从 Senior 到 Staff+ 的差别主要体现在哪里？
q_en: Where does the Senior-to-Staff+ difference mainly show?
why: 差别在于量化取舍并绑到可测结果，如「nprobe 32→64 加 3ms 换 2% recall」「result 缓存吃 30–40% 流量」。把决定挂到 p99、recall@10、每查成本上才是 Staff 信号。
why_en: Not more components but quantifying tradeoffs and tying choices to measurable outcomes — p99 latency, recall@10, cost per query — like 'nprobe 32 to 64 adds 3ms for 2% recall'.
options: Staff+ 会画出比别人更多的组件、做出更复杂的架构图来体现深度
Staff+ 把取舍量化、绑到可测结果（p99、成本等指标），而非只多堆组件
Staff+ 只是用了比别人更多的术语，名词听起来显得更高级而已
Staff+ 会刻意避免提到任何数字，始终保持架构描述抽象干净
options_en: Staff+ draws noticeably more components and builds a more complex architecture diagram to show depth.
Staff+ quantifies tradeoffs and ties choices to measurable outcomes (p99, cost, etc.), rather than stacking components.
Staff+ just uses noticeably more terminology and fancier-sounding nouns than everyone else.
Staff+ deliberately avoids stating any numbers at all, always keeping the architecture description clean and abstract.
optionExplanations: 多堆组件不是资深信号，反而可能是过度设计；关键是取舍是否量化。
对，能把每个决定量化成具体数字并对应到指标，才是资深工程师的真正标志。
堆术语不等于深度，Staff+ 靠的是可测量的取舍论证不是词汇量。
Staff+ 恰恰更爱给数字（+3ms 换 2% recall），回避数字反而显得空。
optionExplanations_en: More components is not a seniority signal and may be over-engineering; the key is whether tradeoffs are quantified.
Correct — tying nprobe/cache-hit/rerank-depth decisions to p99, recall, and cost is the Staff+ differentiator.
Piling jargon is not depth; Staff+ relies on measurable tradeoff arguments, not vocabulary.
Staff+ favors numbers (+3ms for 2% recall); avoiding numbers reads as hand-waving.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务一次查询消耗的算力/金钱，随重排深度、编码器大小、缓存命中率变化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cost per query is the compute/money to serve one query, varying with re-rank depth, encoder size, and cache hit rate.

q: 把一次语义搜索请求在 <200ms 预算下流经的阶段排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order the stages one semantic-search request flows through under the <200ms budget:
steps: 查询理解：蒸馏编码器把 query 编成稠密向量（约 20–30ms）
ANN 召回：scatter-gather 扇出到各分片取 top-k 候选（约 30–50ms）
两段式重排：蒸馏粗排剪枝 + full cross-encoder 精排（约 50–80ms）
网络/序列化：合并去重、protobuf 打包返回（约 20–30ms）
why: 顺序是编码→召回→重排→网络返回，每段吃掉 200ms 里的一块。前段用便宜快的模型缩候选，最贵的 cross-encoder 只精排少量，靠这个漏斗把总延迟压进 p99 预算。
why_en: Encode, retrieve, re-rank, then serialize back, each taking a slice of 200ms, with cheap early stages shrinking candidates so the costly cross-encoder handles only a few.
diagram:
flowchart LR E["编码 query
20–30ms"] --> A["ANN 召回
30–50ms"] A --> R["两段式重排
50–80ms"] R --> N["合并+序列化
20–30ms"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 查询并行发到所有分片，协调器合并去重各分片的局部结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Scatter-gather fans a query to all shards and a coordinator merges/dedups their partial results.

scenario: 你给 result 缓存设 TTL。索引每季度全量重建一次、每天还有小幅增量更新，你担心缓存返回已过期的旧结果。
scenario_en: You set the result cache TTL. The index rebuilds fully quarterly with small daily increments, and you worry the cache serves stale results.
q: result 缓存的 TTL 该按什么来定？
q_en: What should the result cache's TTL be tied to?
why: result 缓存 TTL ≈ 索引重建周期：结果基于某版索引算出，索引一变就可能过期，TTL 不能长过更新周期；embedding 缓存反而可驻留久得多，因编码器很少变。
why_en: Tie the result cache TTL to index rebuild/update cadence, because results are computed against a specific index version and go stale when it changes, whereas the embedding cache persists far longer.
tradeoff: TTL 绑索引节奏（结果不过期·命中率受更新频率限制） vs 长 TTL（命中率高·返回过期结果）
options: 按编码器的更新节奏来定，编码器很少变所以 TTL 可以设得很长
按索引重建/更新节奏定，索引一变旧结果就过期，TTL 不能长过更新周期
直接设成永不过期，全靠手动清缓存来完成更新
按用户的会话时长来定，会话一结束就清空全部结果缓存
options_en: Tie it to encoder update cadence; encoders rarely change so the TTL can be set very long.
Tie it to index rebuild/update cadence; when the index changes old results go stale, so TTL must not exceed the update period.
Set it to have no TTL at all and update purely by manually clearing the cache.
Tie it to the user's session length, clearing all result cache the moment a session ends.
whenOtherWins: 对 query→向量的 embedding 缓存才该按编码器节奏设长 TTL——那一层只随编码器换版失效，与索引更新无关。
whenOtherWins_en: The embedding cache (query to vector) is what gets a long, encoder-cadence TTL — it only invalidates on encoder version changes, not index updates.
optionExplanations: 编码器节奏管的是 embedding 缓存；result 缓存依赖索引，用编码器节奏会返回过期结果。
对；结果基于某版索引，索引更新后旧结果失真，TTL 必须跟着重建/更新周期收。
永不过期 + 手动清理易漏清、返回过期结果，规模化下不可靠。
会话时长与索引新鲜度无关，热门查询跨会话共享缓存才有价值。
optionExplanations_en: Encoder cadence governs the embedding cache; the result cache depends on the index, so encoder cadence would serve stale results.
Correct — results are built on an index version, so after updates old results are wrong and TTL must follow the rebuild/update period.
No TTL at all plus manual clearing risks missed purges and stale results — unreliable at scale.
Session length is unrelated to index freshness; hot queries sharing cache across sessions is where the value is.

termDefinitions.meaning: 基于旧版索引算出、索引更新后已不再准确的缓存结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A stale result is a cached answer computed on an old index version that is no longer accurate after an update.

scenario: 面试速记：ANN 选型不能只报索引名，要报判据。
scenario_en: Interview cheat: never just name an ANN index — state the selection criteria.
q: 补全 ANN 选型的三条判据与两索引定位：
q_en: Fill in the three ANN selection criteria and where each index fits:
text: 选 ANN 索引别只报名字，要给三条判据：{{语料规模}}、{{内存预算}}、目标 {{recall}}。召回至上且内存够 → {{HNSW}}；十亿级且内存紧 → {{IVF-PQ}}。
text_en: Don't just name an ANN index — state three criteria: {{corpus size}}, {{memory budget}}, and target {{recall}}. Recall paramount with ample memory → {{HNSW}}; billion-scale under tight memory → {{IVF-PQ}}.
why: 面试加分点是把选型挂到判据上：规模决定能不能单机、内存预算决定压不压缩、目标 recall 决定容不容忍近似损失。三者一说，HNSW/IVF-PQ 的取舍就自然落地。
why_en: The interview signal is tying the choice to criteria: scale, memory budget, and target recall, which naturally lands the HNSW vs IVF-PQ tradeoff.

termDefinitions.meaning: 高 recall、吃内存的图索引，适合召回至上且内存够。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) is a high-recall, memory-heavy graph index for recall-paramount, ample-memory cases.

termDefinitions.meaning: 省内存、召回略低的聚类+量化索引，适合内存紧的十亿级。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IVF-PQ (Inverted File + Product Quantization) is a memory-thrifty, slightly-lower-recall index for tight-memory billion-scale.
